name: Kang-Petrov Arms KP-45 Tactical 'Sledge'
description:
The Kang-Petrov KP-45 Tactical is the heavy-caliber variant of the ubiquitous KP platform, chambered in .45 ACP with a threaded barrel, suppressor-height sights, and an accessory rail. The frame is wider than the standard KP-19, accommodating a double-stack .45 magazine that gives the weapon a distinctly blocky, aggressive profile.

Kang-Petrov designed the Sledge for contract security operators who need more stopping power than 9mm but can't justify the expense of a Volkov-Saito or Arcturus platform. It delivers .45 ACP performance at a price point that bulk purchasers find acceptable, with the same parts-availability advantage that makes the KP-19 so popular. The threaded barrel accepts standard suppressors, making it one of the cheapest suppressor-ready .45 platforms on the market.

The Sledge is the workhorse's bigger, meaner sibling. It lacks refinement but compensates with brute functionality. Security teams who operate in noise-sensitive environments — residential districts, hospital corridors, corporate campuses after hours — favor it for its suppressor compatibility and adequate performance at a fraction of premium pricing.
legality: Legal — standard registration; suppressor requires separate license
specifications:
caliber: .45 ACP
effective_range: 45 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 12 rounds
weight: 0.95 kg
tactical_use: A suppressor-ready duty pistol offering .45 ACP stopping power at budget pricing. Effective for security operations in noise-sensitive environments when paired with a suppressor. The double-stack magazine provides reasonable capacity for the caliber. Suitable for close to medium range engagements against unarmored and lightly armored targets.
cultural_context: The Sledge is the weapon of choice for security contractors who need results without corporate branding. It carries no prestige and no stigma — it is simply a tool. In the Mid districts, seeing a security guard with a suppressed Sledge is unremarkable, which is exactly the point.
story_hooks: A suppressed Sledge is used in an assassination that was meant to look like a security response — the weapon is traced to a legitimate security contractor who claims it was stolen.
Kang-Petrov is releasing a smart-link compatible KP-45S, and someone is sabotaging the production line.

physical_description.visual_profile: A chunky, utilitarian semi-automatic pistol with an aggressive squared-off profile. The wide frame and blocky slide give it a brutish, no-nonsense appearance — built for function over finesse. The slide-to-frame ratio creates a purposeful silhouette that screams 'working weapon' rather than precision instrument.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length 203mm, slide width 35mm, frame height 138mm, barrel length 127mm with threading visible at muzzle
physical_description.weight_description: Hefty but manageable — 0.95kg settles solidly in the palm with a forward-heavy balance when unloaded. The mass feels purposeful rather than cumbersome, suggesting real stopping power without being unwieldy.
physical_description.primary_material: Steel-reinforced polymer frame with hardened steel slide and barrel. The polymer exhibits visible ribbing for structural integrity.
physical_description.finish: Matte black slide with a slightly worn, service-grade patina suggesting field use. Frame features a textured dark gunmetal-gray polymer with subtle brush marks from manufacturing. No unnecessary shine — tactical aesthetics dominate.
physical_description.color_scheme: Matte black slide with dark gunmetal-gray polymer frame. Stainless steel threaded barrel muzzle provides subtle metallic contrast.
physical_description.grip_texture: Aggressively textured polymer grip with vertical stippling patterns for enhanced purchase. Designed to bite into gloved hands — no ergonomic coddling.
distinctive_features: Suppressor-height tritium front sight post (faintly glowing amber)
Picatinny rail underneath frame in front of trigger guard
Wide, squared-off slide with sharp edges
Double-stack magazine well creating pronounced magazine bulge
Takedown lever positioned for gloved operation
Faint witness holes on frame sides indicating round count
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Kang-Petrov logo stamped on slide rear. 'KP-45 TACTICAL SLEDGE' markings on frame right side. Caliber and serialization on frame left. Small Φ currency symbol indicating 2226-era manufacture near trigger guard.
physical_description.condition_typical: Well-maintained but field-worn. Slide shows light holster marks and micro-scratches. Frame retains original finish with minimal wear. A weapon that's been regularly cleaned and serviced rather than abused — the duty weapon of a professional with a budget.
